source:
William McKinley runs as the establishment Republican while William Jennings Bryan brings a radically different agenda to the race. The bad economy and the coinage of silver dominate discussion.

  • McKinley will make the case for traditional Republican policies, including a strong defense of the gold standard.
  • Bryan will state that there can be no relief for debtors or the larger economy without inflation, which he hopes to bring about via "free silver".
zh:
威廉·麦金莱代表共和党建制派参选，威廉·詹宁斯·布赖恩则提出截然不同的激进纲领。低迷的经济与银币铸造问题，主导着竞选讨论。

  • 麦金莱将捍卫传统共和党政策，尤其是坚定维护金本位制。
  • 布赖恩将主张，若没有通货膨胀，债务人乃至整个经济就无法得到纾困；他希望通过“自由铸银”推动通胀。

source:
Congratulations! You have won the 1896 election.

In spite of a real scare from Mr. Bryan, you have done your part to preserve good order in the United States.

None of that changes the fact that the country is facing a depression with millions out of work. Are you the man to lead the nation back into greatness?

Your first order of business will be tariff increases to stimulate industry, as well as a new commitment to the gold standard.
zh:
恭喜！你赢得了 1896 年的选举。

尽管布赖恩先生确实吓坏了您，但您已经尽了自己的努力来维护美国的良好秩序。

所有这些都没有改变这样一个事实：该国正面临着数百万人失业的萧条。你是带领国家走向伟大的人吗？

您的首要任务将是提高关税以刺激行业，以及对金本位制的新承诺。

source:
Sorry! You have lost the 1896 election.

The titans of American industry were counting on you to put down this nonsense idea of free silver, and to protect them from the other whims of the populist Democrats. Your defeat will go down as one of the most ignominous in the history of American politics.

Bryan's victory stings all the more because after the inept Cleveland Administration, this election shouldn't have been close. Needless to say, your political career is over.
zh:
抱歉！你输掉了 1896 年的选举。

美国工业巨头指望你能放下自由铸银这个无稽之谈的想法，并保护他们免受民粹主义民主党的其他异想天开的影响。你的失败将成为美国政治史上最耻辱的失败之一。

布赖恩的胜利更加刺痛，因为在无能的克利夫兰政府之后，这次选举本来不应该是势均力敌的。不用说，你的政治生涯已经结束了。

source:
Wow! You have won a true nail-biter.

No candidate achieved a majority of the electoral votes, marking the first time this has happened since 1824. Fortunately for you, the majority of U.S. states have Republican controlled congressional delegations, and they will cast their votes for you accordingly.

The important thing is that you won. Go about implementing your agenda accordingly, and pay no attention to Democrats and agitators who call for 'compromise' and 'conciliation'.
zh:
哇！您赢得了真正的胜利。

没有候选人获得多数选举人票，这是自 1824 年以来第一次出现这种情况。对您来说幸运的是，美国大多数州都有共和党控制的国会代表团，他们会相应地为您投票。

重要的是你赢了。相应地执行你的议程，不要理会那些呼吁“妥协”和“和解”的民主党人和煽动者。

source:
Congratulations! You have won the 1896 election.

"The Great Commoner" will soon be President of the United States! Nobody with your political views has ever sniffed the Presidency, let alone won it, and with that in mind your supporters are rioting frenziedly in the streets. The sweetest speech of all will be your victory speech tomorrow in Lincoln, Nebraska. Prepare to enact your reform agenda and most importantly the free coinage of silver.
zh:
恭喜！你赢得了 1896 年的选举。

“伟大的平民”即将成为美国总统！从未有持你这种政治观点的人接近总统宝座，更不用说赢得大选。因此，你的支持者正在街头狂欢。最令人振奋的演说，将是你明天在内布拉斯加州林肯市发表的胜选演说。准备推行你的改革议程吧，尤其是自由铸造银币。

source:
Sorry! You have lost the 1896 election.

With all of the maneuvering, chicanery, and propoganda that the Republicans threw at you, it's amazing that you even had a chance.

Regardless of the outcome this time, you have built a legion of devoted followers who will support anything you do. If you play your cards right, you just might get another shot against McKinley in four years...
zh:
抱歉！你输掉了 1896 年的选举。

尽管共和党对你进行了各种诡计、欺骗和宣传，但你居然还有机会，真是太神奇了。

无论这次结果如何，你已经建立了一批忠实的追随者，他们会支持你所做的任何事情。如果你的牌打对了，你可能会在四年内再次对抗麦金莱……

source:
Sorry! You have lost in a squeaker.

No candidate achieved a majority of the electoral votes, marking the first time this has happened since 1824. Unfortunately for you, the majority of U.S. states have Republican controlled congressional delegations, and they will cast their votes for William McKinley.

Given the incredibly close nature of the election, you can certainly set your sights on a political comeback in 1900, if that is what you desire.
zh:
抱歉！你已经输给了吱吱声。

没有候选人获得多数选举人票，这是自 1824 年以来第一次发生这种情况。对您来说不幸的是，美国大多数州都有共和党控制的国会代表团，他们将投票给威廉·麦金莱。

鉴于选举结果极其接近，您当然可以将目光投向 1900 年的政治东山再起，如果您愿意的话。

source: Which of the following will be your primary campaign message?
zh: 以下哪一项将是您的主要竞选信息？

source: What points do you wish to touch upon as you accept the Republican nomination? A written transcript will be transmitted to voters across the country.
zh: 当您接受共和党提名时，您希望谈及哪些要点？书面记录将发送给全国各地的选民。

source: You have the support of the important newspapers, and they are willing to accept your guidance on the proper campaign message. What do you want them to print?
zh: 你得到了重要报纸的支持，他们愿意接受你对正确竞选信息的指导。您希望他们打印什么？

source: What is your opinion on measures that would aim to restrict the sale or production of alcohol?
zh: 您对旨在限制酒精销售或生产的措施有何看法？

source: Some of the border states (Virginia, Maryland, Kentucky) are very close this year. Do you have a strategy to make these states jump to the Republican side?
zh: 一些边境州（弗吉尼亚州、马里兰州、肯塔基州）今年的情况非常接近。你有策略让这些州跳到共和党一边吗？

source: The West Coast is a very competitive region. Can you make the case for Republican policies there, particularly in those places such as San Francisco which rely on foreign trade?
zh: 西海岸是一个竞争非常激烈的地区。您能否阐述共和党在那里的政策，特别是在旧金山等依赖外贸的地方？

source: What is your definitive position on the tariff issue?
zh: 您在关税问题上的明确立场是什么？

source: Can you state your definitive position on the American monetary system?
zh: 您能阐明您对美国货币体系的明确立场吗？

source: Will you send campaigners to Nebraska, in an attempt to deliver an embarrassing defeat to Bryan, or should those resources be focused on South Dakota, Wyoming, and Iowa?
zh: 您会派活动人员前往内布拉斯加州，试图给布赖恩带来一场尴尬的失败，还是应该将这些资源集中在南达科他州、怀俄明州和艾奥瓦州上？

source: Bryan's nomination has electrified the western voter, and he is now planning to campaign on the rails, six days a week. Will you break precedent as well and make a speaking tour of the nation?
zh: 布赖恩的提名让西方选民兴奋不已，他现在正计划每周六天的竞选活动。您是否也会打破先例，进行全国巡回演讲？

source: The United States is in the midst of a financial calamity, with masses of unemployed men on the streets. What will you do to revive business in this country?
zh: 美国正处于金融灾难之中，大量失业人员流落街头。您将采取什么措施来重振这个国家的商业？

source: Grover Cleveland sent federal troops to Illinois to end the Pullman Strike without the request of Governor Altgeld. Was this an overreach on his part?
zh: 格罗弗·克利夫兰在未经阿尔特盖德州长请求的情况下派遣联邦军队前往伊利诺伊州结束普尔曼罢工。这是他的越权行为吗？

source: Some people have suggested implementing a minimum wage, under which people may not be employed. Do you think this would help increase wages or would it simply put more men out of work?
zh: 有些人建议实施最低工资，低于该工资标准的人可能无法就业。您认为这会有助于提高工资还是只会让更多的男性失业？

source: Do you have any comments to make about the candidacy of John Palmer, a Gold Democrat and splinter candidate who is currently campaigning?
zh: 您对目前正在竞选的金民主党和分裂候选人约翰·帕尔默的候选资格有什么评论吗？

source: You have received checks for $250,000 from J.P. Morgan and from Standard Oil, not to mention innumerable contributions from other concerned businessmen. How will you exploit this immense advantage in funding that you have?
zh: 您已从摩根大通和标准石油公司收到了 250,000 美元的支票，更不用说其他相关商人的无数捐款了。您将如何利用您拥有的这一巨大的资金优势？

source: Are you prepared to reaffirm our commitment to the Monroe Doctrine, should any new territories in Latin America gain independence from Spain?
zh: 如果拉丁美洲的任何新领土从西班牙手中获得独立，您是否准备好重申我们对门罗主义的承诺？

source: Do you believe that the federal government has any right to issue interest-bearing bonds, such as those sold to J.P. Morgan in 1895?
zh: 您认为联邦政府有权发行有息债券，例如 1895 年出售给摩根大通的债券吗？

source: Do you think that local jurisdictions should be allowed to use hanging or other forms of capital punishment for crimes?
zh: 您认为地方司法管辖区是否应该允许对犯罪行为使用绞刑或其他形式的死刑？

source: Was it an appropriate intervention of the federal government to attach U.S. mail cars to Pullman trains during the strike in 1894? (Thereby making it a federal crime to interfere with the passage of these cars)
zh: 1894 年罢工期间，联邦政府将美国邮车附在普尔曼火车上是否是适当的干预？ （从而使干扰这些汽车的通行成为联邦犯罪）

source: It has been alleged that opportunistic young women have married Union Army veterans for the sole purpose of exploiting the pension system. Do you consider this to be a form of corruption? Would you implement some standards that widows must meet before they can inherit these pensions?
zh: 据称，机会主义的年轻女性与联邦军退伍军人结婚的唯一目的是利用养老金制度。您认为这是一种腐败吗？您会执行寡妇在继承这些养老金之前必须满足的一些标准吗？

source: Should Confederate veterans be included in the federal Civil War pension system?
zh: 南部邦联退伍军人是否应该纳入联邦南北战争养老金体系？

source: Should there be greater regulation or even price controls on railroad shipping rates?
zh: 是否应该对铁路运费进行更严格的监管甚至价格控制？

source: Will you work towards international agreements to create a monetary system based on "bimetallism", i.e. a combination of gold and silver?
zh: 您会致力于达成国际协议，以创建基于“复本位制”（即黄金和白银的组合）的货币体系吗？

source: Do you believe that immigrant labor is undermining the American worker? Should there be some restrictions put into place on immigration?
zh: 您认为移民劳工正在损害美国工人吗？是否应该对移民施加一些限制？

source: There is one week left until election day. Every state is important, but where will you give an extra push with what is left of your financial resources to educate the American voters?
zh: 距离选举日还剩一周。每个州都很重要，但你将用剩下的财政资源在哪里额外推动教育美国选民呢？

source: I am a proud "wet" in the alcohol debate. What a man drinks is no one's business but his own.
zh: 我是酒精辩论中自豪的“湿”者。一个人喝什么不关别人的事，只关他自己的事。

source: It's a shame that Grover Cleveland allowed his supporters to bolt the party the moment it became clear their faction had lost this year's nomination.
zh: 令人遗憾的是，格罗弗·克利夫兰在他们的派别明显失去今年的提名后就允许他的支持者退出该党。

source: Good riddance. On the issue of silver coinage, you are either with us or you're with the industrialists. Palmer has shown his cards.
zh: 摆脱了。在银币问题上，你要么支持我们，要么支持实业家。帕尔默已经亮出了底牌。

source: I don't know how this man could live with four years of William McKinley just to save the face of his friend Grover Cleveland. No true Democrat would vote for him.
zh: 我不知道这个人如何能够忍受四年的威廉·麦金莱只是为了挽回他朋友格罗弗·克利夫兰的面子。没有一个真正的民主党人会投票给他。

source: I'm very concerned about John Palmer. If he is gaining support maybe it means there is a valid criticism we must face up to.
zh: 我非常关心约翰·帕尔默。如果他获得支持，也许意味着我们必须面对合理的批评。

source: My opponent's ideas are almost as dangerous to the survival of the United States as the Democratic traitors were in the 1860s.
zh: 我对手的想法对于美国的生存来说几乎和 1860 年代的民主党叛徒一样危险。

source: I am the candidate who brings the reasonable, tested ideas of sound money, protection, and prosperity. Bryan on the other hand will usher in radicalism and instability.
zh: 我是带来稳健货币、保护和繁荣的合理且经过检验的想法的候选人。布赖恩另一方面将迎来激进主义和不稳定。

source: My campaign will reach out to workers across the American spectrum, while Bryan's policies will leave them defenseless against foreign competition and will debase their wages.
zh: 我的竞选活动将覆盖美国各个阶层的工人，而布赖恩的政策将使他们在面对外国竞争时毫无防御能力，并会降低他们的工资。

source: My administration will bring back the era of the budget surplus, and will work towards the professionalization of the federal government. We will continue to phase out the 'spoils system' in accordance with the Pendleton Act.
zh: 我的政府将带回预算盈余时代，并将致力于联邦政府的专业化。我们将根据彭德尔顿法案继续逐步淘汰“政党分赃制”。

source: I appreciate the faith of the American people and consult always with the Lord before I make my decisions. I will run a moderate, sensible agenda that appeals to the broad majority.
zh: 我欣赏美国人民的信仰，并在我做出决定之前始终咨询主。我将制定一个温和、合理的议程，以吸引大多数人。

source: Labor agitators and agrarian radicals are threatening to overthrow our system of government. They have put forward a preposterous array of Constitutional Amendments and confiscatory welfare programs.
zh: 劳工煽动者和农业激进分子威胁要推翻我们的政府制度。他们提出了一系列荒谬的宪法修正案和没收福利计划。

source: Democrats who believe in the gold standard are welcome in our party. We will increase tariffs, to be sure, but in a moderate way that addresses their concerns.
zh: 我们党欢迎相信金本位制的民主党人。当然，我们会提高关税，但会以温和的方式来解决他们的担忧。

source: William Jennings Bryan makes an eloquent appeal to the heart. It's important for voters to realize that his solutions will not help our country.
zh: 威廉·詹宁斯·布赖恩雄辩地诉诸内心。选民必须认识到他的解决方案对我们的国家没有帮助，这一点很重要。

source: Bryan's naked ambition knows no bounds. It is unbecoming of a candidate to make campaign appearances on his own behalf.
zh: 布赖恩赤裸裸的野心是没有界限的。候选人以自己的名义参加竞选活动是不合适的。

source: There's no way I can compete with Bryan's oratorical talents. Instead, I will receive groups of visitors at my home in Canton, Ohio. We have the financing to pay for these visits, and anyone who shows up will receive a free sandwich while I deliver a speech.
zh: 我无法与布赖恩的演讲天赋竞争。相反，我将在我位于广州的家中接待成群的访客，俄亥俄州。我们有资金支付这些访问的费用，在我发表演讲时，任何到场的人都会收到一份免费三明治。

source: I will return these checks. It is not appropriate for politics to be infused with this kind of money.
zh: 我将退还这些支票。向政治注入这种金钱是不合适的。

source: We will print and mail campaign material in massive quantities. We will hire speakers to blanket the four corners of the nation. We will print ads every day in every major paper. Bryan cannot compete with us on money.
zh: 我们将大量印刷、邮寄竞选材料。我们将聘请演说者，走遍全国各地。我们每天都会在每一份主要报纸上刊登广告。在资金上，布赖恩根本无法与我们竞争。

source: I can't attack Bryan like the papers can without losing some of my luster. Let them publish the defamatory cartoons and opinion pieces.
zh: 我无法像论文那样攻击布赖恩，同时又不会失去一些光彩。让他们发表诽谤性的漫画和观点文章。

source: The big newspapers should remind the voters that I represent a return to prosperity after the Democratic disaster of the previous four years. They should be paying as little attention to Bryan as possible.
zh: 大报纸应该提醒选民，我代表着在过去四年的民主党灾难之后恢复繁荣。他们应该尽可能少地关注布赖恩。

source: I'm not comfortable coordinating my message with the press. I trust that they will find the right way to present a contrast between me and my opponent.
zh: 我不太愿意与媒体协调我的信息。我相信他们会找到正确的方式来呈现我和我的对手之间的对比。

source: Bryan would drive the important railroads of this region, such as Union Pacific, into bankruptcy by reneging on agreed-upon financing arrangements.
zh: 布赖恩将因违背商定的融资安排而导致该地区的重要铁路公司（例如联合太平洋铁路公司）破产。

source: Bryan is the type of do-gooder politician who would attempt to impose his own morality on this independent region.
zh: 布赖恩是那种试图将自己的道德强加给这个独立地区的行善政治家。

source: One of my highest priorities in office will be a canal through Nicaragua, which will greatly enhance our national trade. Democrats lack the ambition for such far-reaching projects.
zh: 我任职期间最优先考虑的事项之一是修建一条穿过尼加拉瓜的运河，这将极大地促进我们的国家贸易。民主党人缺乏实施此类影响深远的项目的雄心。

source: Much of California's livelihood comes from gold mining. I reject any call to undermine gold through the free coinage of silver.
zh: 加利福尼亚州的大部分生计来自金矿开采。我拒绝任何通过自由铸造白银来破坏黄金的呼吁。

source: There is a certain element of conservatism in the southern states. I don't think that their temperament aligns with that of Bryan. I will simply repeat the message that he is a radical.
zh: 南部各州存在一定的保守主义成分。我不认为他们的气质与布赖恩相符。我只想重复一下他是激进分子的信息。

source: As a Civil War veteran, I am uniquely positioned to preach a message of sectional unity and Americanism. These states must know that we have allowed bygones to be bygones.
zh: 作为一名南北战争退伍军人，我具有独特的地位来宣扬部门团结和美国主义的信息。这些国家必须知道我们已经让过去的事情成为过去。

source: There is a burgeoning textile industry in the Upper South. Their success depends on cheap cotton, protection, and an absence of destabilizing labor issues.
zh: 上南部纺织业蓬勃发展。它们的成功取决于廉价棉花、保护以及不存在破坏稳定的劳工问题。

source: I will remind them that we support Cuban independence.
zh: 我会提醒他们，我们支持古巴独立。

source: We are running a 45-state strategy. I want our victory and repudiation of the silver Democrats to be as large as possible.
zh: 我们正在实施 45 个州的战略。我希望我们的胜利和对白银民主党的否定尽可能大。

source: That's not a good idea. Let's be realistic and devote our efforts to the states that matter.
zh: 这不是一个好主意。让我们现实一点，为重要的州奉献我们的努力。

source: Our speakers should converge on Illinois from all directions. We need to blanket this state with advertising and with political parades.
zh: 我们的演讲者应该从各个方向汇聚到伊利诺伊州。我们需要用广告和政治游行来覆盖这个国家。

source: Let's take the fight to Bryan. I want us to be campaigning the hardest in Missouri, Nebraska, Kansas, and Iowa. Our extra cash will ensure a landslide on election night.
zh: 让我们战斗到布赖恩。我希望我们在密苏里州、内布拉斯加州、堪萨斯州和艾奥瓦州中进行最努力的竞选活动。我们的额外现金将确保选举之夜获得压倒性胜利。

source: Let's continue to focus on the Midwest. Ohio, Illinois, Indiana, Michigan, etc.
zh: 让我们继续关注中西部。俄亥俄州、伊利诺伊州、印第安纳州、密歇根州等

source: I want us to put all of our spare resources into Iowa and Minnesota.
zh: 我希望我们将所有的闲置资源投入到艾奥瓦州和明尼苏达州中。

source: We need to shore up our base. Let's make sure we win in Pennsylvania and New York, where the stakes are highest.
zh: 我们需要巩固我们的基地。让我们确保我们在赌注最高的宾夕法尼亚州和纽约州中获胜。

source: I support a strict adherence to the gold standard, which is fundamental to American prosperity.
zh: 我支持严格遵守金本位制，这是美国繁荣的基础。

source: Limited silver coinage is a good compromise. I support a program like that of Bland-Allison where the government purchases around $2 million of silver each month.
zh: 有限的银币是一个很好的妥协。我支持像 Bland-Allison 这样的计划，政府每月购买大约 200 万美元的白银。

source: I support the free, unlimited coinage of silver at the current market price of 30-to-1 against gold. This ratio should be frequently adjusted to match actual prices in order to avoid another run on the Treasury's gold supply.
zh: 我支持以当前市场价格与黄金 30 比 1 的比例免费、无限地铸造白银。应经常调整该比率以匹配实际价格，以避免财政部黄金供应再次出现挤兑。

source: I support the free, unlimited coinage of silver at a fixed price ratio of 16-to-1 against gold.
zh: 我支持以与黄金 16 比 1 的固定价格比率免费、无限地铸造白银。

source: Tariffs should be limited to the minimum amount necessary to raise sufficient revenue for the federal government.
zh: 关税应限制在为联邦政府筹集足够收入所需的最低金额。

source: In limited areas where we have new industries forming, tariffs can be higher. They should be low on most products.
zh: 在新产业形成的有限地区，关税可能会更高。大多数产品的价格应该很低。

source: Where we have mature, stable industries, tariffs can be lower. They should be high on most products.
zh: 我们有成熟、稳定的产业，关税可以更低。大多数产品的含量都应该很高。

source: We need high tariffs on a variety of products and commodities to stimulate American manufacturing.
zh: 我们需要对各种产品和商品征收高关税来刺激美国制造业。

source: The Democratic idea has been that if you legislate to make the masses prosperous, their prosperity will find its way up through every class which rests upon them. We need to help our farmers and our workers by allowing the coinage of silver.
zh: 民主党的想法是，如果你立法让群众富裕，他们的繁荣就会通过他们所依赖的每个阶级而实现。我们需要通过允许铸造银币来帮助我们的农民和工人。

source: It's time we think about implementing a series of public works projects to occupy our excess labor force. This will improve business by placing more money in the hands of consumers.
zh: 现在是我们考虑实施一系列公共工程项目来占用我们过剩劳动力的时候了。这将通过将更多的钱交到消费者手中来改善业务。

source: I can't stress this enough. The most important thing we can do right now is increase our tariffs to protect American business.
zh: 我怎么强调都不为过。我们现在能做的最重要的事情就是提高关税以保护美国企业。

source: We need to reaffirm our commitment to non-intervention in business affairs. Companies need stability before they will have the confidence to expand.
zh: 我们需要重申不干预商业事务的承诺。公司需要稳定才能有信心扩张。

source: This was the act of a tyrant. Pullman was engaged in abominable business practices, and in the darkest hour Cleveland cast his lot with the company over the working man.
zh: 这是暴君的行为。普尔曼从事令人憎恶的商业行为，在最黑暗的时刻，克利夫兰将自己的命运与公司一起抛弃了工人。

source: Governor Altgeld was working to mediate the dispute between the Pullman Company and the strikers when Cleveland interfered. There should have absolutely been more time given for these sides to reach an accommodation.
zh: 当克利夫兰介入时，州长阿尔特盖德正在努力调解普尔曼公司和罢工者之间的纠纷。绝对应该给这些双方更多的时间来达成和解。

source: It's not the job of government to regulate labor disputes, but the fact of the matter is that these strikers were allowing no rail traffic to pass through Chicago whatsoever. Something needed to be done.
zh: 监管劳资纠纷不是政府的职责，但事实是这些罢工者不允许任何铁路交通通过芝加哥。需要做点什么。

source: Bargaining for wages is the business of a man and his employer. Collective bargaining has no place in American society, and I commend Grover Cleveland for having the courage to act decisively.
zh: 讨价还价是一个人和他的雇主的事。集体谈判在美国社会没有立足之地，我赞扬格罗弗·克利夫兰有果断行动的勇气。

source: It is my dream to see a Prohibition Amendment passed before I die.
zh: 我的梦想是在我死前看到禁酒令修正案获得通过。

source: These measures are a step in the right direction. Nothing destroys so many lives in this country as does the pernicious habit of drinking alcohol.
zh: 这些措施是朝着正确方向迈出的一步。在这个国家，没有什么比有害的饮酒习惯更能毁掉如此多的生命了。

source: Perhaps if our goal is to prevent drinking on Sunday, or public drunkenness, I am all for those measures. But a blanket temperance law is a different story.
zh: 也许如果我们的目标是防止周日饮酒或公共场合酗酒，那么我完全赞成这些措施。但全面禁酒法却是另一回事。

source: Railroads gouge hardworking American farmers year after year, while giving preferred rates to large companies. I won't allow it.
zh: 铁路年复一年地欺骗勤劳的美国农民，同时向大公司提供优惠费率。我不会允许的。

source: I will examine this issue very carefully. If government has helped to finance some of these railroads, it's only fair for government to have a say in their operations.
zh: 我会非常仔细地研究这个问题。如果政府为其中一些铁路提供资金，那么政府在其运营中拥有发言权才是公平的。

source: Only on rare occasions where there is a clear abuse from the railroads. For the most part they simply charge what the traffic will bear.
zh: 仅在极少数情况下，铁路存在明显的滥用行为。在大多数情况下，他们只是根据流量承受的程度收取费用。

source: I doubt that it is even Constitutional for the federal government to control railroad rates. This will never happen in my Administration.
zh: 我怀疑联邦政府控制铁路费率是否符合宪法。这在我的政府中永远不会发生。

source: It's time that the two halves of our country fully reconciled. Confederate veterans should be helped as much as Union veterans.
zh: 现在是我们国家的两半完全和解的时候了。南部邦联退伍军人应该像联邦退伍军人一样得到帮助。

source: There's just one problem with this idea -- Confederate veterans will never accept money from the Federal government. Since they deem this idea to be an exercise in humiliation, I am left with no choice but to oppose it myself.
zh: 这个想法只有一个问题——南部邦联退伍军人永远不会接受联邦政府的资金。既然他们认为这种想法是一种羞辱，我别无选择，只能自己反对。

source: I will not support a program that delivers pension funds to the very men who rebelled against our Constitution. I hope this is the last time I ever have to answer this question.
zh: 我不会支持向那些反抗我们宪法的人提供养老基金的计划。我希望这是我最后一次回答这个问题。

source: One can never be sure when the inspiration of love will strike. Widows' pensions should be protected unconditionally.
zh: 人们永远无法确定爱情的灵感何时会降临。寡妇的抚恤金应得到无条件保护。

source: Have you seen some of these couples? I believe if a marriage was initiated after 1880, then the pension benefits should cease upon the death of the veteran.
zh: 你见过这些情侣吗？我认为，如果1880年之后结婚，那么养老金福利应该在退伍军人去世后停止。

source: This is just another sad chapter in the fiscal mismanagement of the veterans' pensions. The best we can do now is to remain vigilant for the day when these pensions are universally offered to all aged veterans.
zh: 这只是退伍军人养老金财政管理不善的又一个悲惨篇章。我们现在能做的最好的事情就是保持警惕，等待向所有老年退伍军人普遍提供这些养老金的那一天。

source: The entire city of Chicago and half of the Midwest was blocked to rail traffic. It was impossible for this fracas not to interrupt U.S. mail.
zh: 整个芝加哥市和中西部一半地区的铁路交通被封锁。这场争吵是不可能的 不 中断美国邮件。

source: We should have found other methods to end this strike besides legal chicanery.
zh: 除了法律欺骗之外，我们应该找到其他方法来结束这次罢工。

source: The Democrats have always been the party of states' rights. I was a little surprised to see Cleveland intervene in this case.
zh: 民主党一直是州权利党。看到克利夫兰介入此案，我有点惊讶。

source: A good man named Eugene Debs was thrown in prison due to the overreach of President Cleveland.
zh: 一个名叫尤金·德布斯的好人因克利夫兰总统的越权行为而被投入监狱。

source: There are individuals in this country working for less than a dollar a day. Only through desperation would a man ever consent to such an arrangement.
zh: 这个国家有些人每天的工作收入不到一美元。只有在绝望的情况下，一个人才会同意这样的安排。

source: This policy is economically unviable. It is also yet another "solution" to our problems which I deem to be unconstitutional.
zh: 这项政策在经济上不可行。这也是我们问题的另一种“解决方案”，我认为这是违宪的。

source: We accept any European who is able to read and write. America will always serve as a place where the oppressed masses can find a new hope.
zh: 我们接受任何能够读写的欧洲人。美国将永远成为被压迫群众找到新希望的地方。

source: We live in an open society, but that should never serve as an excuse for business to undermine the American worker by paying pauper wages to new arrivals.
zh: 我们生活在一个开放的社会，但这绝不应该成为企业通过向新来者支付微薄工资来损害美国工人利益的借口。

source: It's time that we had severe restrictions on who we let into this country. A walk down the streets of New York is hardly distinguishable from the Tower of Babel, and these new arrivals crush the bargaining power of the American worker.
zh: 现在是我们对进入这个国家的人进行严格限制的时候了。走在纽约州的街道上很难与巴别塔区分开来，这些新来者削弱了美国工人的讨价还价能力。

source: The international system we have in place is the gold standard. Not only is this highly advisable from a business standpoint, but it is driven by the power of Great Britain. We are better off working within this system.
zh: 我们现有的国际系统是金本位制。这不仅从商业角度来看是非常明智的，而且是受到英国实力的推动。我们最好在这个系统内工作。

source: This is something we should work for to reform the monetary supply. That being said, the United States should not unilaterally leave the gold standard until we have some agreement in place.
zh: 这是我们货币供给改革应该努力的方向。话虽如此，在我们达成某种协议之前，美国不应单方面退出金本位制。

source: This would be a worthwhile arrangement for the laboring classes across the civilized world. When I'm elected, however, we will allow the free coinage of silver regardless of what agreements are or aren't in place.
zh: 对于整个文明世界的劳动阶级来说，这将是一个有价值的安排。然而，当我当选时，无论是否达成了哪些协议，我们都将允许自由铸造白银。

source: We will vigorously enforce the Monroe Doctrine, the same way that we have since 1823. This includes support for the struggles of the people in Cuba, should they gain independence. We also appreciate Grover Cleveland's vigorous action in Venezuela last year.
zh: 我们将像 1823 年以来那样大力执行门罗主义。这包括支持古巴人民的斗争（如果他们获得独立）。我们也赞赏克利夫兰去年在委内瑞拉采取的积极行动。

source: I support the Monroe Doctrine as established American policy.
zh: 我支持门罗主义作为美国既定政策。

source: This is an outdated doctrine that could needlessly commit the United States to an unnecessary war. We should view any such blanket statements with grave suspicion.
zh: 这是一个过时的学说，可能不必要地让美国陷入不必要的战争。我们应该以严重怀疑的态度看待任何此类笼统的声明。

source: This is perfectly within the realm of acceptable punishment.
zh: 这完全在可接受的惩罚范围内。

source: I have sought the guidance of our Savior on this issue, and I cannot support the execution of our lost souls in good conscience.
zh: 我已经在这个问题上寻求我们救世主的指导，但我不能凭良心支持处决我们迷失的灵魂。

source: The moneychangers of the temple duped (or bribed) Grover Cleveland into issuing gold bonds. While the rest of the country suffered in indignation, bankers like J.P. Morgan and the Rothschilds made off with millions.
zh: 圣殿的货币兑换商欺骗（或贿赂）格罗弗·克利夫兰发行黄金债券。当全国其他地区都在愤慨之际，摩根大通和罗斯柴尔德家族等银行家却卷走了数百万美元。

source: Of course the government has a right to do this. Whether it is advisable or whether President Cleveland negotiated a good interest rate is another debate.
zh: 政府当然有权这样做。无论是否明智，或者克利夫兰总统是否通过谈判达成了良好的利率，都是另一回事。

source: The federal government has every right to issue interest bearing bonds. Of course, under a solvent Administration there would be no cause for doing so. This whole episode reflects more poorly on the performance of President Cleveland than it does on any great legal issue.
zh: 联邦政府完全有权发行计息债券。当然，在有偿付能力的政府领导下，没有理由这样做。整个事件比任何重大法律问题都更能反映出克利夫兰总统的糟糕表现。

source: The newspapers are noting that you have emphasized your Union Army roots and drawn the lines clearly against Bryan's misplaced extremism.
zh: 报纸注意到您强调了您的联邦军根源，并明确反对布赖恩错误的极端主义。

source: This is a good, moderate appeal that should draw sensible voters from across the spectrum.
zh: 这是一个很好的、适度的呼吁，应该会吸引来自各个领域的明智选民。

source: Labor leaders are skeptical, but at the same time Mr. Bryan is known to be primarily a farmers' candidate.
zh: 工党领袖对此表示怀疑，但同时众所周知，布赖恩先生主要是一名农民候选人。

source: These are good motives, but the spoils system has been in decline for years. Most voters are more worried about finding work and regaining prosperity.
zh: 这些都是很好的动机，但政党分赃制多年来一直在衰退。大多数选民更担心找到工作和恢复繁荣。

source: The humble nature of your personality is widely noted, and stands in stark contrast to the braggadocio of your opponent.
zh: 你性格中的谦虚本性广为人知，与对手的吹牛形成鲜明对比。

source: You come off as a bit of an extremist with such rhetoric, but then again your opponent does the same every time he opens his mouth.
zh: 这样的言论让你显得有点极端，但你的对手每次开口都会做同样的事情。

source: It sounds like you are making for a strong play for the type of moderate who used to vote for Cleveland before that man's incompetence was exposed.
zh: 听起来你正在为那种在克利夫兰的无能暴露之前曾投票支持克利夫兰的温和派做出强有力的贡献。

source: Mr. McKinley, don't be naive. You have the press on your side, now use it!
zh: 麦金莱先生，别天真了。媒体就在您身边，现在就使用它！

source: Lord knows the railroad men can swing an election. But then again, so can the railroad workers. California will be a close state.
zh: 天知道铁路人可以左右选举。但话又说回来，铁路工人也可以。加利福尼亚州将处于关闭状态。

source: It's not out of the question for you to sweep the middle plains, but everything will have to go just perfectly for you.
zh: 横扫中原对你来说不是不可能，但一切都必须对你来说完美。

source: This is probably a better idea. By no means do you need to win Nebraska to become President.
zh: 这可能是一个更好的主意。您绝不需要赢得内布拉斯加州才能成为总统。

source: Settle into a nice, comfortable chair and wait for the telegraph results to come in. Downtown Canton is thronged with supporters who await a glimpse of you.
zh: 坐在一张漂亮、舒适的椅子上，等待电报结果的到来。坎顿市中心挤满了支持者，他们等待着你的一睹。

source: This is a vigorous, straightforward defense of your views on the gold standard.
zh: 这是对您对金本位制观点的有力、直接的辩护。

source: There are gold men and there are silver men. Compromise on this issue does not fit into the mood of the moment.
zh: 有金人，也有银人。在这个问题上妥协不符合当前的情绪。

source: This is a disappointing answer to your supporters.
zh: 对于您的支持者来说，这是一个令人失望的答案。

source: You have broken with the party line and with your past legislation. Voters are confused and businessmen are furious.
zh: 你已经违反了党的路线和过去的立法。选民感到困惑，商人感到愤怒。

source: This is an unwelcome change of position to your supporters and contributors.
zh: 对于您的支持者和贡献者来说，这是不受欢迎的立场变化。

source: This is a reasonable point of view that pleases your supporters.
zh: 这是一个令你的支持者高兴的合理观点。

source: Loud cheers from the audience! A tariff man through and through!
zh: 观众热烈欢呼！一个彻头彻尾的关税人！

source: The Democratic idea? You are a Republican.
zh: 民主党的想法？你是一名共和党人。

source: Republicans are known to love ambition, but building for the sake of building? Just to pick up the slack for a bunch of loafers? Not so much.
zh: 众所周知，共和党人热爱野心，但为了建设而建设？只是为了弥补一堆懒汉鞋的空缺吗？没那么多。

source: The rail strikes threw most of the country into fear and panic. They were pleased when Cleveland put an end to the madness.
zh: 铁路罢工使全国大部分地区陷入恐惧和恐慌。当克利夫兰结束了这种疯狂时，他们很高兴。

source: After an electoral massacre in 1890, Republicans have been trying to step back from the temperance issue. You're not helping them.
zh: 1890 年的选举大屠杀之后，共和党人一直试图退出禁酒问题。你没有帮助他们。

source: This is a little to the morally conservative side vis-a-vis most Americans.
zh: 相对于大多数美国人来说，这在道德上有点保守。

source: This is a moderate answer that offends very few people.
zh: 这是一个温和的答案，冒犯了很少的人。

source: A 'wet' is not the best reputation to have in this day and age.
zh: 在当今时代，“湿”并不是最好的声誉。

source: A criticism of pensions for Union Army veterans? Not the best move politically.
zh: 对联邦军退伍军人养老金的批评？这不是政治上最好的举动。

source: Sympathy for Eugene Debs? This will not help you in the fall.
zh: 同情尤金·德布斯？这对你秋天没有帮助。

source: Cheap labor depends on a steady influx of immigrants.
zh: 廉价劳动力取决于移民的稳定涌入。

source: This is the sort of uncompromising rhetoric on the silver issue that you are rapidly becoming known for. No matter though -- everyone dislikes Grover Cleveland.
zh: 这就是您正在迅速出名的关于白银问题的那种毫不妥协的言论。不管怎样——每个人都不喜欢格罗弗·克利夫兰。

source: Your supporters are in shock. You can make every effort to explain that you were misquoted, but you have lost a bit of your trustworthiness.
zh: 你的支持者感到震惊。你可以尽一切努力解释你被错误引用，但你已经失去了一点可信度。

source: There are gold men and there are silver men. Compromise on this issue does not fit into the mood of the moment, especially since this represents a change in position from your silver advocacy.
zh: 有金人，也有银人。在这个问题上做出妥协并不符合当前的情绪，特别是因为这代表了你们对白银主张的立场发生了变化。

source: This is a strong pro-silver answer, while still acknowledging the difficulties a fixed price could cause in the Treasury.
zh: 这是一个强烈支持白银的答案，同时仍然承认固定价格可能会给财政部带来困难。

source: This is music to the ears of your farmer constituency.
zh: 这对于您的农民选区来说是美妙的音乐。

source: You have stuck to the party line on this issue.
zh: 在这个问题上你坚持党的路线。

source: I see what you're doing, and I like it. It might not be a bad thing to compromise on some issues outside of silver coinage.
zh: 我看到你在做什么，我喜欢它。在银币之外的一些问题上妥协也许不是坏事。

source: You have drifted a little far from your core beliefs here. Farmers are upset with you.
zh: 你在这里偏离了你的核心信念。农民们对你很不满。

source: Boos and hisses from the audience! This is what the 'Boy Orator of the Platte' came to talk about?!
zh: 观众的嘘声和嘶嘶声！这就是“普拉特男孩演说家”来谈论的事情？！

source: One of your favorite lines -- and a favorite of your supporters also.
zh: 你最喜欢的台词之一——也是你的支持者最喜欢的台词。

source: You have aligned yourself with Coxey and his army. We'll see how that turns out.
zh: 你已经与考克西和他的军队结盟了。我们将看看结果如何。

source: What? You're supposed to be a man of the people, not of the trusts.
zh: 什么？你应该是人民的人，而不是信托的人。

source: This view is a little out of the mainstream, but not that much.
zh: 这种观点有点脱离主流，但也不是那么严重。

source: Are you taking the side of Grover Cleveland over that of hard-working American railroad men?
zh: 您是否站在格罗弗·克利夫兰一边，而不是勤奋的美国铁路工人一边？

source: This is another case where your earnest Christian beliefs might be better left unstated.
zh: 这是另一种情况，您最好不要说出您真诚的基督教信仰。

source: You cannot close Pandora's Box. Fifteen percent of Americans were born abroad and they will not abide by this rhetoric.
zh: 你无法关闭潘多拉魔盒。百分之十五的美国人出生在国外，他们不会遵守这种言论。

source: What is your interpretation of the antitrust statutes? Do large American business profit from monopolistic practices?
zh: 您对反垄断法规有何解释？美国大企业是否从垄断行为中获利？

source: John Palmer, a Gold Democrat, is also running against Bryan. He has offered to remove his name from the ballot on the East and West Coast if you will do the same in the South. He argues that this will consolidate the anti-Bryan vote. What do you think?
zh: 约翰·帕尔默，一名金民主党人，也在竞选布赖恩。他提出，如果你愿意在南部做同样的事情，他将把自己的名字从东海岸和西海岸的选票中删除。他认为这将巩固反对布赖恩的投票。你怎么认为？

source: Is it generally appropriate for federal courts to issue injunctions against striking unions?
zh: 联邦法院发布针对工会罢工的禁令通常是否合适？

source: Do you think that there should be federal oversight of the New York and Chicago trading markets?
zh: 您认为纽约州和芝加哥交易市场应该受到联邦监督吗？

source: Grover Cleveland led the push to repeal the Sherman Silver Purchase Act in 1894. What are your thoughts on his actions during that period?
zh: 格罗弗·克利夫兰 (Grover Cleveland) 领导推动废除 1894 年《谢尔曼白银购买法案》。您对他在此期间的行为有何看法？

source: Some labor leaders have called for regulation standardizing a ten or even an eight hour workday. Do you support these calls?
zh: 一些劳工领袖呼吁制定法规，将十小时甚至八小时的工作日标准化。你支持这些呼吁吗？

source: The Wilson-Gorman Tariff Act of 1894 lowered the rates on many goods, while still falling well short of Cleveland's ideal levels. What do you think about this act as a whole?
zh: 1894 年的威尔逊-戈尔曼关税法案降低了许多商品的税率，但仍远低于克利夫兰的理想水平。您对整个行为有何看法？

source: In general, is the Supreme Court too obstructionist in their rulings on economic issues? Would you appoint judges who would bring a new perspective to these issues?
zh: 总体而言，最高法院对经济问题的裁决是否过于阻挠？您会任命能够为这些问题带来新视角的法官吗？

source: Would you support a program to compensate workers who are injured on the job? Is this a proper responsibility of the federal government?
zh: 您是否支持一项补偿因工受伤工人的计划？这是联邦政府应有的责任吗？

source: What do you have to say about William Jennings Bryan's campaign, at a high level?
zh: 您对威廉·詹宁斯·布赖恩的活动有什么高层次的看法？

source: Bryan combines vague, non-sensical appeals to emotion with a near-blasphemous use of religious symbolism. I'm confident that the voters will reject this demagogue.
zh: 布赖恩将模糊、无意义的情感诉求与近乎亵渎的宗教象征主义结合起来。我相信选民会拒绝这个煽动者。

source: Free coinage of silver will debase our currency and make a mockery of us to the rest of the world.
zh: 自由铸造白银将使我们的货币贬值，并让世界其他地方嘲笑我们。

source: William Jennings Bryan is a devout, honest man. It's unfortunate that he proposes such misguided policies.
zh: 威廉·詹宁斯·布赖恩是一个虔诚、诚实的人。不幸的是，他提出了如此误导性的政策。

source: Our campaign is much better positioned to address the concerns of ordinary Americans than Bryan's. He is overly focused on the silver issue.
zh: 我们的竞选活动比布赖恩的竞选活动更能解决普通美国人的担忧。他过于关注白银问题。

source: Absolutely not. Can you imagine how it would look if we removed ourselves from the ticket in any state? And for an old man like Palmer?
zh: 绝对不是。你能想象如果我们在任何州将自己从罚单中删除会是什么样子吗？那么对于像帕尔默这样的老人呢？

source: If Palmer will remove himself from the ballot in Kentucky, Indiana, West Virginia, Maryland, and Delaware, then I will give him free reign in the Deep South.
zh: 如果帕尔默将从肯塔基州、印第安纳州、西弗吉尼亚州、马里兰州和特拉华州的选票中删除自己，那么我将给予他在深南部的自由统治权。

source: I hope Palmer will see fit to remove himself unilaterally from the most hotly contested border states. His is purely a protest candidacy however, and I cannot remove myself from a ballot on his behalf without looking like a buffoon.
zh: 我希望帕尔默认为单方面从争议最激烈的边境州撤出是合适的。然而，他纯粹是一个抗议候选人，我不能代表他从选票中退出，否则看起来就像个小丑。

source: I am willing to make an expansive deal with Palmer. He may remain on the ballot in Illinois, but must remove himself completely from the other northern states. In turn I will give him free reign in the entire South.
zh: 我愿意与帕尔默达成一项广泛的协议。他可能会留在伊利诺伊州的选票上，但必须完全远离其他北部各州。反过来，我将给予他在整个南方的自由统治权。

source: I support the coinage of silver, and this action was a step in the wrong direction. It took money out of the system when we needed it the most, and is partly to blame for the depth of our current downturn.
zh: 我支持白银铸币，这一行动是朝着错误方向迈出的一步。当我们最需要的时候，它从系统中抽走了资金，这也是我们当前经济严重衰退的部分原因。

source: Unfortunately the Treasury was bankrupt. I do think that Cleveland approached this in the usual heavy-handed, abrasive manner, but he was absolutely in the right. This whole episode demonstrates the folly of silver coinage.
zh: 不幸的是，财政部破产了。我确实认为克利夫兰以惯常的严厉、粗暴的方式处理了这个问题，但他绝对是正确的。整个事件证明了银币的愚蠢之处。

source: We can criticize Cleveland for a lot of things, but his repeal of the Silver Purchase Act is not one of them. I supported Cleveland all the way in the repeal debate.
zh: 我们可以批评克利夫兰的很多事情，但他废除白银购买法案并不是其中之一。我在废除辩论中一直支持克利夫兰。

source: We would also like to move a little more in the direction of lower tariffs, but overall this is a good law.
zh: 我们还希望朝着降低关税的方向进一步努力，但总的来说，这是一项很好的法律。

source: I am disappointed with the half measures taken in this act. If Senators were directly elected by the people, they would be less beholden to the types of financial interests who wrote their own tariffs into this law.
zh: 我对这一行为中采取的半措施感到失望。如果参议员由人民直接选举产生，他们就不会那么受那些将自己的关税写入该法律的经济利益集团的影响。

source: This act was the result of countless hours of compromise and negotiations. It's time we closed this issue and stopped changing our entire tariff system every time a new Administration takes over.
zh: 这一行为是无数小时妥协和谈判的结果。是时候我们解决这个问题并停止在每次新政府上任时改变我们的整个关税制度了。

source: My first action as President will be to reinstate higher tariffs. This is an American policy that supports American factories and American workers.
zh: 作为总统，我的第一个行动将是恢复更高的关税。这是支持美国工厂和美国工人的美国政策。

source: When I am President, you will finally have someone who takes our antitrust legislation seriously. I will break up monopolistic banks and railroads in places where they stifle competition.
zh: 当我担任总统时，你们终于会有一个认真对待我们的反垄断立法的人了。我将在扼杀竞争的地方打破垄断银行和铁路。

source: I take a very narrow view of the term "monopoly". There is a need for these statutes but they open up a lot of danger for political witch hunts.
zh: 我对“垄断”一词的看法非常狭隘。这些法规是必要的，但它们给政治迫害带来了很多危险。

source: I favor a hands-off approach to the economy. The federal government has no business stepping in and breaking a company into pieces.
zh: 我赞成对经济采取不干涉的态度。联邦政府无权介入并将一家公司拆散。

source: We absolutely need a federal program for this purpose. The Bible says that we must love all people -- even those who have been cast aside by our Darwinian industrial machinery.
zh: 为此目的，我们绝对需要一个联邦计划。圣经说我们必须爱所有人——即使是那些被达尔文工业机器抛弃的人。

source: This is more properly a state responsibility. It is outside the scope of the federal government to regulate working conditions in this manner.
zh: 更准确地说，这是国家责任。以这种方式规范工作条件不属于联邦政府的职责范围。

source: It is the responsibility of the worker to put aside such funds as are necessary to protect them from these events. This is why we have mutual aid societies in place.
zh: 工人有责任预留必要的资金以保护他们免受这些事件的影响。这就是我们设立互助协会的原因。

source: Not only would this greatly improve working conditions for Americans, it would increase employment by spreading our working hours amongst more people.
zh: 这不仅会极大地改善美国人的工作条件，还会通过将我们的工作时间分散到更多人身上来增加就业。

source: I am a strong supporter of labor, but I also think that working hour restrictions are more appropriate for women and children than for grown men.
zh: 我是劳工的坚定支持者，但我也认为工作时间限制更适合女性和儿童，而不是成年男性。

source: I do not see the authority for regulating this under the Commerce Clause of the Constitution. This is something that individual states would need to investigate.
zh: 我认为宪法的商业条款没有对此进行监管的权力。这是各个州需要调查的事情。

source: I don't believe that outside parties should regulate the working arrangements between a man and his employer.
zh: 我认为外部各方不应规范男性与其雇主之间的工作安排。

source: If we could manage it, I would increase the number of justices on the Court so that we can dissipate the influence of the reactionaries presently in control there.
zh: 如果我们能够做到这一点，我会增加法院法官的数量，以便我们能够消除目前控制在那里的反动派的影响力。

source: Absolutely. I will appoint sensible, assertive judges as President. The purpose of the Court is not to simply overturn half of the laws passed by Congress, on picayune Constitutional objections.
zh: 当然。我将任命明智、果断的法官担任总统。法院的目的并不是简单地因宪法反对而推翻国会通过的一半法律。

source: It is not my place as a politician, running for a position in the Executive Branch, to comment on the performance of the Court.
zh: 作为一名竞选行政部门职位的政治家，我没有资格对法院的表现发表评论。

source: The poor man is called a socialist if he believes that the wealth of the rich should be divided among the poor, but the rich man is called a financier if he devises a plan by which the pittance of the poor can be converted to his use.
zh: 如果穷人相信富人的财富应该分给穷人，那么他就被称为社会主义者；但如果富人制定了一项计划，可以将穷人的微薄之物转化为他的用途，那么他就被称为金融家。

source: It was stock market and railroad company chicanery which caused the Panic of 1893. Sensible regulation of this process could have saved us all a lot of trouble.
zh: 正是股票市场和铁路公司的欺骗行为导致了 1893 年的恐慌。对这一过程的明智监管本来可以为我们所有人省去很多麻烦。

source: The New York Stock Exchange is a private company providing liquidity to other companies. The last thing our fragile economy needs is some hare-brained intervention in this process.
zh: 纽约州证券交易所是一家向其他公司提供流动性的私营公司。我们脆弱的经济最不需要的就是在这一过程中进行一些轻率的干预。

source: There has already been considerable reform of the stock markets since the dangerous days of the 1860s. There's no need to take this idea any further.
zh: 自 1860 年代的危险时期以来，股票市场已经进行了相当大的改革。没有必要再继续这个想法了。

source: The use of injunctions is a favored court tactic for union busting and it must stop. I support the right of striking workers to picket their workplace while on strike.
zh: 使用禁令是法庭打击工会的常用策略，必须停止。我支持罢工工人在罢工期间在工作场所设置纠察线的权利。

source: Maybe in limited cases, where unions are a threat to public safety or where they undermine an essential industry. The courts are notoriously conservative, however, and definitely take this practice too far.
zh: 也许在有限的情况下，工会对公共安全构成威胁或破坏了重要行业。然而，法院是出了名的保守，而且这种做法肯定太过分了。

source: The Pullman Strike of 1894 disrupted half of the nation's rail traffic and threatened to throw our society into complete turmoil. A small group of radicals should never have the power to disrupt the lives of millions.
zh: 1894 年的普尔曼罢工扰乱了全国一半的铁路交通，并有可能使我们的社会陷入彻底的混乱。一小群激进分子永远不应该拥有扰乱数百万人生活的力量。

source: You have echoed the concern of many immigrants and moderates that Bryan is a religious fundamentalist.
zh: 您回应了许多移民和温和派的担忧，即布赖恩是宗教原教旨主义者。

source: You should also be concerned about appearances. If you receive 0 votes in the entire South, you may well lose the national popular vote like Harrison in 1888 even while you win the election.
zh: 你还应该关心外表。如果你在整个南方获得0票，即使你赢得了选举，你也很可能会像1888年的哈里森一样失去全国普选票。

source: This is a limited compromise. Palmer of course is an old man who will lose all of the states you conceded him, but every vote will count in Kentucky.
zh: 这是一个有限的妥协。帕尔默当然是一位老人，他将失去你让给他的所有州，但每一张选票都将计入肯塔基州。

source: You may win a close state without Palmer on the ballot, but your willingness to cut this deal has the whiff of a scandal in certain quarters.
zh: 你可能会在没有帕尔默的情况下赢得一个势均力敌的州，但你愿意达成这项协议在某些方面带有丑闻的味道。

source: Keep pointing out the practical problems associated with silver coinage so that Americans can make an informed decision this November.
zh: 继续指出与银币相关的实际问题，以便美国人能够在今年 11 月做出明智的决定。

source: Frightening comments to hear from a so-called Republican!
zh: 从所谓的共和党人那里听到的可怕评论！

source: Businessmen are confused about your apparent disregard for law and order.
zh: 商人对你对法律与秩序的明显漠视感到困惑。

source: It's a bit uncomfortable when you discuss the near bankruptcy of the Treasury. After all, wouldn't silver coinage just cause this same problem again?
zh: 当你讨论财政部濒临破产时，这有点不舒服。毕竟，银币不会再次引发同样的问题吗？

source: Your supporters hate the railroads, and you should fall in line with their wishes.
zh: 你的支持者讨厌铁路，你应该符合他们的意愿。

source: Workers are hoping you would take a stronger stand on this, as the man of the people in this election.
zh: 工人们希望您在这次选举中作为人民的代表，在此问题上采取更强硬的立场。

source: Jacob Coxey's protests fell on deaf ears in 1894. With so many men out of work, is there any role for a public works program that would keep them occupied until business improves?
zh: 1894 年，雅各布·考克西 (Jacob Coxey) 的抗议被置若罔闻。在如此多的人失业的情况下，公共工程计划是否可以发挥作用，让他们有事可做，直到生意好转？

source: What do you have to say about your own Christian faith? And how does it inform your political views?
zh: 对于你自己的基督教信仰，你有什么话要说的？它如何影响你的政治观点？

source: Do you believe that the federal government should monitor and improve important waterways in the interests of commerce, such as the Mississippi River?
zh: 您是否认为联邦政府应该为了商业利益而监控和改善重要的水道，例如密西西比州河流？

source: John Rockefeller is concerned about the possible effects of the Sherman Antitrust Act, passed in 1890. It seems that certain rabble-rousers believe this law should be used to break up Standard Oil. Can you reassure him that you will take a narrow interpretation of this law in your Administration?
zh: 约翰洛克菲勒担心 1890 年通过的《谢尔曼反托拉斯法》可能产生的影响。似乎某些煽动者认为应该利用这项法律来瓦解标准石油公司。你能否向他保证你会在你的政府中对这项法律采取狭隘的解释？

source: Today it looks like it's the Milwaukee Chamber of Commerce who have made the trip to your house. Do you have something inspiring to tell them in your speech?
zh: 今天看来是密尔沃基商会拜访了您家。您在演讲中有什么鼓舞人心的话要告诉他们吗？

source: I feel like discussing the incredible danger that Bryan represents to our Republic.
zh: 我想讨论布赖恩对我们共和国所带来的难以置信的危险。

source: I am a proud Methodist. We all pray to the same Christian God and there is no need to use divisive, radical religious rhetoric.
zh: 我是一名自豪的卫理公会教徒。我们都向同一个基督教上帝祈祷，没有必要使用分裂的、激进的宗教言论。

source: We all believe in God. I am just as Christian as Mr. Bryan. No more. No less.
zh: 我们都相信上帝。我和布赖恩先生一样是基督徒。不再。不少。

source: My faith calls for the true equality of man. Our Constitution enshrines the ideals that each man has God-given rights which cannot be ignored by any earthly power.
zh: 我的信仰呼吁人类真正平等。我们的宪法庄严宣扬这样的理想：每个人都拥有上帝赋予的权利，任何世俗权力都不能忽视这些权利。

source: Today we will cover the need for religious tolerance. The Republicans are a party for all Americans.
zh: 今天我们将讨论宗教宽容的必要性。共和党是所有美国人的政党。

source: John D. Rockefeller has nothing to fear from a McKinley Administration. I reject the calls of certain mountebanks for the break-up or socialization of Standard Oil.
zh: 约翰·D. 洛克菲勒无需担心麦金莱政府。我拒绝某些江湖骗子要求拆分或社会化标准石油公司的呼吁。

source: Rockefeller knows my positions well. I feel as if it would be unbecoming to give him personal assurances, however. I work for all of the American people.
zh: 洛克菲勒很了解我的立场。然而，我觉得给他个人保证似乎是不合适的。我为所有美国人民工作。

source: This antitrust legislation was passed with good reason. Business competition will inherently fail wherever monopolies exist.
zh: 这项反垄断立法的通过是有充分理由的。只要存在垄断，商业竞争必然会失败。

source: Let's talk about the importance of reviving American business. Our tariff act will give them the protections they need to succeed.
zh: 让我们谈谈重振美国商业的重要性。我们的关税法案将为他们提供成功所需的保护。

source: Let's discuss world affairs. I support the annexation of Hawaii and I support the independence of Cuba. I support a stronger Navy.
zh: 让我们讨论世界大事。我支持吞并夏威夷州，我支持古巴独立。我支持更强大的海军。

source: Every man should have a right to bargain for his own wages. Let us reaffirm our opposition to collective bargaining and to radical labor unions.
zh: 每个人都应该有权为自己的工资讨价还价。让我们重申反对集体谈判和激进的工会。

source: Let's remind the voters that we will clean government up after four years of Democratic incompetence.
zh: 让我们提醒选民，在民主党四年无能之后，我们将清理政府。

source: Let's address our speech to the workers and voters of the mid-Atlantic, who have been abandoned by the Democrats' nominee for this election.
zh: 让我们向大西洋中部的工人和选民发表演讲，他们在这次选举中被民主党提名人抛弃了。

source: If we could be sure that the benefits would spread equally to the different states, I think a public works program could be helpful at this point.
zh: 如果我们能够确定收益会平均分配到不同的州，我认为公共工程计划在这一点上可能会有所帮助。

source: I'm sure that Mr. Coxey is a well-intentioned citizen, but I see no constitutional authority for implementing a federal public works program.
zh: 我确信考西先生是一位善意的公民，但我认为宪法没有授权实施联邦公共工程计划。

source: This is absolutely the wrong solution to our business downturn. We must increase tariffs to stimulate American business.
zh: 对于我们的业务低迷来说，这绝对是错误的解决方案。我们必须提高关税来刺激美国商业。

source: This is absolutely the wrong solution to our business downturn. We must allow the free coinage of silver to reduce the burden of our debts.
zh: 对于我们的业务低迷来说，这绝对是错误的解决方案。我们必须允许白银自由铸币以减轻我们的债务负担。

source: Internal areas of the country have the same rights to use our waterways as the coastal regions. Making the Mississippi more navigable and more flood-resistant could prove to be an economic windfall.
zh: 国内地区与沿海地区享有相同的使用我们水道的权利。使密西西比州更容易通航、更耐洪可能会带来一笔意外的经济收益。

source: This is another costly project that promises very little return on our investment.
zh: 这是另一个耗资巨大的项目，我们的投资回报率极低。

source: This is not regulation of commerce under the Commerce Clause. This is direct action by the federal government to build and operate a public works project. I'm not sure that this is Constitutional.
zh: 这不是商业条款下的商业规定。这是联邦政府为建设和运营公共工程项目而采取的直接行动。我不确定这是否符合宪法。

source: Rockefeller gives you a solemn nod of approval. His support will be priceless this fall.
zh: 洛克菲勒郑重点头表示同意。今年秋天，他的支持将是无价的。

source: Rockefeller gives you a silent, unmistakable glare. He never thought he'd live to see a Republican of your ilk speaking out against his business.
zh: 洛克菲勒给您一种安静、明确的眩光。他从未想过自己会活着看到像你们这样的共和党人公开反对他的生意。

source: Bryan's reputation amongst industrial workers is actually suspect (he is often perceived as being too pro-farmer and too evangelical). Do you have any plans to win this traditionally Democratic block of voters?
zh: 布赖恩在产业工人中的声誉实际上是值得怀疑的（他经常被认为过于支持农民和过于福音派）。您有什么计划来赢得这个传统的民主党选民群体吗？

source: Should corporations be permitted to hire private detectives for security, and to infiltrate into labor movements?
zh: 是否应该允许企业聘请私家侦探进行安全保卫并渗透到劳工运动中？

source: Do you think that the United States Navy is large enough to adequately defend American interests on a global level?
zh: 您认为美国海军的规模是否足以在全球范围内充分捍卫美国的利益？

source: Will you press for your party to include a condemnation of lynching in the party platform?
zh: 您会敦促您的政党在党纲中加入对私刑的谴责吗？

source: Should there be some regulation of working hours for children, particularly those under the age of 12 or 13?
zh: 是否应该对儿童（尤其是 12 岁或 13 岁以下的儿童）的工作时间进行一些规定？

source: Business owners should threaten the workers with further unemployment if Bryan wins.
zh: 如果布赖恩获胜，企业主应该以进一步失业来威胁工人。

source: We will remind laborers that inflation will debase the value of their wages. Silver coinage is a rural policy.
zh: 我们将提醒劳动者，通货膨胀会降低他们的工资价值。银币是农村政策。

source: Let's remind the immigrant populations that Bryan is a religious fanatic who opposes the sale of alcohol.
zh: 让我们提醒移民人群，布赖恩是一位反对售酒的宗教狂热分子。

source: Americans are one people. We will not do special messaging for special interest groups.
zh: 美国人是一个民族。我们不会为特殊利益群体发送特殊消息。

source: It agonizes me that we do not have this protection in place. Have we not seen children who are seven years old losing their hands in the cotton looms?
zh: 令我痛苦的是我们没有这种保护措施。难道我们没有见过七岁的孩子在织布机上失去双手吗？

source: I believe this is warranted in the industrial trades. Let us not forget that all hands are needed on the farm, not least of all in this day and age.
zh: 我相信这在工业行业是有道理的。我们不要忘记，农场需要所有人的帮助，尤其是在当今时代。

source: It falls outside the scope of the Constitution for the federal government to regulate the working conditions within a factory. This is not something that the President has control over.
zh: 联邦政府规范工厂内的工作条件不属于宪法的范围。这不是总统可以控制的事情。

source: The Navy is more than adequate to meet our current needs, and will remain so as long as imperialist Republicans avoid intervening in Cuba or Hawaii.
zh: 海军足以满足我们当前的需求，并且只要帝国主义共和党避免干预古巴或夏威夷州，海军就将保持这种状态。

source: I am disappointed with the backward status of our Navy. We need a more vigorous fleet, and we need a canal in Nicaragua to more closely link our two coasts.
zh: 我对我们海军的落后状况感到失望。我们需要一支更有活力的舰队，我们需要尼加拉瓜的一条运河来更紧密地连接我们的两个海岸。

source: This is another sad attempt to crush the spirit of the working man. It's difficult to distinguish between Pinkertons and vigilantes during some of these repression actions.
zh: 这是又一次摧毁工人精神的可悲尝试。在一些镇压行动中，很难区分平克顿分子和治安维持者。

source: Perhaps if collective bargaining was protected, companies would have less cause to fear their own employees.
zh: 也许如果集体谈判受到保护，公司就没有理由担心自己的员工。

source: I don't see who has the authority to stop this. This is another example of regulation that would fall outside of the scope of the Commerce Clause in the Constitution.
zh: 我不知道谁有权阻止这一切。这是不属于宪法商业条款范围的监管的另一个例子。

source: The practice of hiring detectives from agencies like the Pinkertons is justified by the militancy and danger of the American labor movement.
zh: 美国劳工运动的战斗性和危险性证明了从平克顿等机构雇佣侦探的做法是合理的。

source: I abhor any instance where extra-judicial punishment is meted out by the passions of an inflamed mob. My party will speak out against this practice in our platform.
zh: 我憎恶任何因愤怒暴徒的激情而实施法外惩罚的情况。我的政党将在我们的政治纲领上公开反对这种做法。

source: This has no hope of becoming law, but we have to include the plank in order to appease the southern delegates who secured my nomination.
zh: 这没有希望成为法律，但我们必须纳入该纲领，以安抚获得我提名的南方代表。

source: This isn't an issue worth addressing. It will please no one and offend everyone, at least within our party's rank-and-file.
zh: 这不是一个值得解决的问题。它不会取悦任何人，而且会冒犯所有人，至少在我们党的普通民众中是这样。

source: These types incidents will happen when the federal government's due process Amendments fail to account for the innate differences among the citizens of the South.
zh: 当联邦政府的正当程序修正案未能考虑到南方公民之间的固有差异时，就会发生此类事件。

source: There's nothing the Republicans can do about it, but at least you have the moral victory of a strong statement against injustice.
zh: 共和党对此无能为力，但至少你通过反对不公正的强烈声明获得了道义上的胜利。

source: Once your views become well-known, Southern Democrats will defect in droves for John Palmer, the Bourbon Democrats' splinter candidate.
zh: 一旦你的观点广为人知，南方民主党人就会成群结队地投奔约翰·帕尔默，即波旁民主党人的分裂候选人。

source: Which of the following most closely matches your overall campaign message?
zh: 以下哪一项最符合您的整体活动信息？

source:
You have alluded to the need for less prejudice between the races. Senator "Pitchfork" Ben Tillman, of South Carolina, privately seeks your clarification.
Can you reassure him that the federal government will respect the rights of the states under your Administration?
zh:
您提到需要减少种族之间的偏见。南卡罗来纳州的参议员“Pitchfork”Ben Tillman 私下寻求您的澄清。
您能否向他保证联邦政府将尊重您政府领导下各州的权利？

source:
You have very little chance of winning New York this fall, and nearly all of that city's newspapers are anti-Bryan. That doesn't mean you couldn't draw a frenzied crowd in New York City.
Perhaps the media attention would be beneficial in building excitement for your campaign on a national scale?
zh:
今年秋天你赢得纽约州的机会很小，而且该市几乎所有报纸都反对布赖恩。这并不意味着你无法在纽约州城市吸引疯狂的人群。
也许媒体的关注有助于在全国范围内激发您的竞选活动热情？

source: What do you have to say about William McKinley's campaign, at a high level?
zh: 您对威廉·麦金莱的活动有什么高层次的看法？

source:
The novelty of a personal visit from the "Great Commoner" could probably swing the West Coast states in your direction. However, it will take two weeks to travel and return via train.
Will you divert your attention from the Midwest long enough to visit California, Oregon, and Washington?
zh:
“伟大平民”亲自访问的新奇可能会让西海岸各州转向你的方向。然而，乘火车往返需要两周时间。
您会将注意力从中西部转移足够长的时间来访问加利福尼亚州、俄勒冈州和华盛顿州吗？

source: What do you think of leaving the Midwest for a week and making a circuit of the crucial upper South states? (i.e. Delaware, Maryland, Virginia, West Virginia, and Kentucky)
zh: 离开中西部一周并绕行重要的上南部各州，您有何看法？ （即特拉华州、马里兰州、弗吉尼亚州、西弗吉尼亚州和肯塔基州）

source: Can you respond to rumors that you would seek to abolish the Supreme Court if elected, due to their recent decisions on the income tax and antitrust issues?
zh: 由于最高法院最近在所得税和反垄断问题上做出的决定，您能否回应有关如果当选您将寻求废除最高法院的传言？

source: Critics have said that you wrap yourself in religious imagery too much for a presidential candidate. What is your response?
zh: 批评者说，对于总统候选人来说，你过多地将自己包裹在宗教意象中。你的回应是什么？

source: Do you support greater regulation on the sale and labeling of opium, cocaine, and morphine when used in patent medicines?
zh: 您是否支持对用于专利药品的鸦片、可卡因和吗啡的销售和标签进行更严格的监管？

source: You are making a big speech in Chicago today. What points will you touch on?
zh: 您今天将在芝加哥发表重要演讲。您会谈到哪些要点？

source: The federal deficit has recently increased after two decades of steady decline. What are your thoughts on this?
zh: 联邦赤字在经历了二十年的稳步下降之后最近有所增加。您对此有何看法？

source: What is your opinion on the overthrow of the Hawaiian monarchy by the Dole group? Do you support the annexation of Hawaii into the United States?
zh: 您对多尔团体推翻夏威夷君主制有何看法？您支持将夏威夷州并入美国吗？

source: A few western states have allowed women the right to vote. Do you take the calls for a women's suffrage Amendment seriously?
zh: 一些西部州允许妇女投票权。您认真对待妇女选举权修正案的呼吁吗？

source: There is one week left until election day. Every state is important, but where will you give an extra push with your personal campaigning to swing the final results?
zh: 距离选举日还剩一周。每个州都很重要，但你会在哪些方面通过你的个人竞选活动来额外推动以改变最终结果呢？

source: We support the free coinage of silver priced at a 16-to-1 ratio against gold. The results will aid farmers and workers of all classes and contribute to an American renewal.
zh: 我们支持以 16 比 1 的价格免费铸造白银与黄金。其结果将帮助农民和各阶层工人，并为美国的复兴做出贡献。

source: We will focus on free-silver and especially on the issues affecting farmers. We will seek a reduction in private debts and an end to the monopolistic practices of the railroads. We will also fight for the lowest possible tariffs.
zh: 我们将重点关注自由白银，特别是影响农民的问题。我们将寻求减少私人债务并结束铁路的垄断行为。我们还将争取尽可能低的关税。

source: Silver coinage is just one part of my platform. Let's not forget the struggles of the urban worker in his efforts to unionize and obtain fair wages.
zh: 银币只是我政治纲领的一部分。我们不要忘记城市工人为加入工会和获得公平工资而进行的斗争。

source: I am 100% committed to the coinage of silver. It's important however, that we strike a moderate tone on other issues to expand our appeal as widely as we can.
zh: 我 100% 致力于银币的铸造。然而，重要的是，我们在其他问题上采取温和的基调，以尽可能广泛地扩大我们的吸引力。

source: McKinley is a fanatical defender of an obsolete monetary system. He is a front-man for big business and the New York financiers.
zh: 麦金莱是过时货币体系的狂热捍卫者。他是大企业和纽约州金融家的代言人。

source: McKinley's support of high tariffs is a crime which strangles American commerce. Similar protectionist programs have twice been rejected by American voters in the past ten years alone.
zh: 麦金莱支持高关税是扼杀美国商业的犯罪行为。仅在过去十年里，类似的保护主义计划就两次被美国选民否决。

source: We may have our disagreements, but William McKinley is an honorable man. Our campaign will focus on the issues, not on the opponent.
zh: 我们可能有分歧，但威廉·麦金莱是一个值得尊敬的人。我们的竞选活动将集中于问题，而不是对手。

source: McKinley's insistence on the gold standard has alienated many prominent Republicans from his own party, such as Henry Teller.
zh: 麦金莱对金本位制的坚持已经疏远了许多知名共和党人与他自己政党的关系，例如亨利·特勒。

source: The Supreme Court has consistently stood in the way of progress by implementing an overly narrow interpretation of the Constitution. I support drastic measures to reduce its influence.
zh: 最高法院一直对宪法实施过于狭隘的解释，从而阻碍进步。我支持采取严厉措施来减少其影响。

source: There have been some terrible decisions made by the Court. We might consider some measures to make the court more accountable to the popular will.
zh: 法院做出了一些可怕的决定。我们可以考虑采取一些措施，让法院更加对民意负责。

source: This is an unfounded rumor that the McKinley campaign has disseminated to discredit my candidacy.
zh: 这是麦金莱竞选活动散布的毫无根据的谣言，旨在抹黑我的候选资格。

source: 8 years of a William Jennings Bryan presidency will leave the Court in much better shape to address our nation's problems.
zh: 8 年的威廉·詹宁斯·布赖恩院长任期将使法院能够更好地解决我们国家的问题。

source: Let us bring our message to the citizens of the Pacific Coast. Winning these three states could swing the entire election.
zh: 让我们向太平洋海岸的公民传达我们的信息。赢得这三个州可能会左右整个选举。

source: Let's keep the tour as short as possible. I will take a train to San Francisco and deliver a few speeches in that city, but will not tour the entire coast.
zh: 让我们的巡演尽可能简短。我将乘火车前往旧金山，并在该市发表一些演讲，但不会游览整个海岸。

source: There is no time for that diversion. Heaven knows what rumors McKinley will spread while I am gone, and winning the Midwest should be our primary focus.
zh: 没有时间进行这种转移。天知道我不在的时候会传播什么谣言麦金莱，赢得中西部应该是我们的首要关注点。

source: New York is a traditional Democratic stronghold, and I'm confident that the people of that state will support my message. We will campaign there extensively.
zh: 纽约州是传统的民主党据点，我相信该州的人民会支持我的信息。我们将在那里进行广泛的宣传活动。

source: Let's not waste our time in a hostile state. We must sow our seed upon the good earth where it will multiply.
zh: 我们不要在敌对状态中浪费时间。我们必须把我们的种子撒在肥沃的土地上，让它繁衍生息。

source: I will give one big speech in New York City to open my campaign. Even if winning that state is hopeless, we need the national press.
zh: 我将在纽约州市发表一场大型演讲来开启我的竞选活动。即使赢得该州毫无希望，我们也需要全国媒体。

source: The humblest citizen in all the land, when clad in the armor of a righteous cause, is stronger than all the hosts of error.
zh: 这片土地上最卑微的公民，当穿上正义事业的盔甲时，就会比所有错误的大军更强大。

source: The word of the Lord demands that we give our attention to the poor, the sick, and the feeble. This campaign is not about me -- I am a mere servant of Christ.
zh: 主的话要求我们关注穷人、病人和体弱的人。这次活动与我无关——我只是基督的仆人。

source: I'm not sure what kind of Christianity the Republicans adhere to, but it is of dubious merit in guiding our government.
zh: 我不确定共和党人坚持哪种基督教，但它在指导我们的政府方面的价值值得怀疑。

source: We will respect the rights of the states. I call for greater understanding, but certainly not for an overthrow of the natural order.
zh: 我们将尊重各州的权利。我呼吁更多的理解，但当然不是推翻自然秩序。

source: There has been a deafening silence for many years on the issue of equal rights in the South. It's time we had a true enforcement of the 14th and 15th Amendment.
zh: 多年来，南方在平等权利问题上一直保持着令人震耳欲聋的沉默。现在是我们真正执行第 14 条和第 15 条修正案的时候了。

source: Tillman and others have nothing to fear from me. It is the sacred duty of the white man to properly instruct and civilize the black man and other inferior races. Greater understanding must occur within this context.
zh: 蒂尔曼和其他人无需担心我。正确教导和教化黑人和其他低等种族是白人的神圣职责。在此背景下必须有更多的理解。

source: We need to keep it simple. Our primary goal in this campaign is to win the critical states of Iowa, Illinois, and Indiana.
zh: 我们需要保持简单。我们本次活动的主要目标是赢得艾奥瓦州、伊利诺伊州和印第安纳州的关键状态。

source: It's a shame that we need to even campaign in these beacons of the South. But if we have to, let us do it with effluence.
zh: 遗憾的是我们甚至需要在南方的这些灯塔中开展竞选活动。但如果必须的话，让我们尽情地去做吧。

source: I will make my standard stump speech highlighting the dangers of the gold standard and advocating for free silver.
zh: 我将发表标准的竞选演讲，强调金本位制的危险并倡导自由铸银。

source: Let's hit on the issue of tariffs. These voters need to be reminded that tariffs increase the cost of farm equipment and other manufactured goods.
zh: 让我们来谈谈关税问题。需要提醒这些选民，关税会增加农业设备和其他制成品的成本。

source: I will speak to the general issues of the future -- free silver, higher wages, worker's rights, an end to child labor, and women's suffrage.
zh: 我将谈论未来的一般问题 - 自由铸银、更高的工资、工人权利、结束童工和妇女选举权。

source: I am a moderate who supports the free coinage of silver. I am not a radical as so many claim. It is McKinley's antiquated insistence on the gold standard that is truly radical.
zh: 我是一个温和派，支持白银自由铸币。我并不像许多人声称的那样是激进分子。真正激进的是麦金莱对金本位制过时的坚持。

source: Overall the deficit is still low. Furthermore, if we allow the free coinage of silver the amount of our deficit will decrease commensurably as our currency inflates.
zh: 总体而言，赤字仍然较低。此外，如果我们允许自由铸造白银，随着我们的货币通胀，我们的赤字金额将相应减少。

source: There would be no increase in the deficit if the Supreme Court hadn't overturned the income tax.
zh: 如果最高法院没有推翻所得税，赤字就不会增加。

source: Once we reinstitute our tariffs, this deficit will disappear. Best of all, the lion's share of these taxes will be paid by foreign merchants.
zh: 一旦我们重新征收关税，这种赤字就会消失。最重要的是，这些税收的大部分将由外国商人支付。

source: I would support such an Amendment if it gained traction within our system. I'm just sorry to see that the chances seem unlikely.
zh: 如果这样的修正案在我们的系统中获得关注，我会支持它。我只是很遗憾地看到这种机会似乎不太可能。

source: We welcome the support of women and men. Where women are granted the vote, we are confident that they will support our ticket.
zh: 我们欢迎女性和男性的支持。如果妇女获得投票权，我们相信她们会支持我们的选票。

source: I think there are more important issues for us to be focusing our efforts on. Extending the suffrage to women carries with it a whole host of dangers.
zh: 我认为还有更重要的问题需要我们集中精力解决。将选举权扩大到女性会带来一系列危险。

source: These men are Americans and they are attempting to bring badly-needed order to the islands of Hawaii. If managed properly, an annexation will allow us to enjoy the benefits of Hawaii's innumerable sugar plantations. These islands are also a perfect location for a naval base.
zh: 这些人是美国人，他们正试图为夏威夷州岛屿带来急需的秩序。如果管理得当，吞并将使我们能够享受夏威夷州无数甘蔗种植园的好处。这些岛屿也是海军基地的理想地点。

source: This cabal may be hoping for recognition from the United States, but for now they are simply a group of Pacific island adventurers. I have no wishes for either their success or their failure.
zh: 这个阴谋集团可能希望得到美国的认可，但目前他们只是一群太平洋岛屿冒险家。我不希望他们成功或失败。

source: We will never recognize or annex the so-called Hawaiian government while I am President.
zh: 在我担任总统期间，我们永远不会承认或吞并所谓的夏威夷政府。

source: I'm scared to take my own medicine sometimes for fear of what might be in there. Medicines should be clearly labeled with their ingredients, so that those who wish to avoid intoxicating substances can do so.
zh: 有时我害怕自己吃药，因为担心里面可能有什么。药品应清楚地标明其成分，以便那些希望避免有毒物质的人可以这样做。

source: Many patent medicine purveyors operate in a single locale, and do not cross state lines. Where appropriate, I would support regulation, but only where the Constitution allows it.
zh: 许多专利药品供应商在单一地点运营，并且不跨越州界。在适当的情况下，我会支持监管，但前提是宪法允许。

source: This isn't an issue we should be concerned about. Additional regulation of drugs and medicinal practice would undermine our national liberty.
zh: 这不是我们应该关心的问题。对药物和医疗实践的额外监管将损害我们的国家自由。

source: Let's spend the entire week in Illinois. That is the largest state that we have a chance to win.
zh: 让我们在伊利诺伊州度过整整一周。这是我们有机会赢得的最大州。

source: Let's make one last general tour of the Midwest. Starting in Ohio, we will travel west and end in North Dakota, before moving down to Nebraska on Election Day.
zh: 让我们进行最后一次中西部巡演。从俄亥俄州开始，我们将向西行驶并在北达科他州结束，然后在选举日前往内布拉斯加州。

source: Let's focus on Iowa and the Dakotas. My presence can swing those states.
zh: 让我们关注艾奥瓦州和达科他州。我的存在可以改变这些状态。

source: Indiana has always been the critical swing state. Let's spend most of our time there while also crossing over into Illinois and Kentucky.
zh: 印第安纳州一直是临界挥杆状态。让我们把大部分时间花在那里，同时也穿越到伊利诺伊州和肯塔基州。

source: We must secure the upper South. This means we start in in Maryland and Delaware, move through Virginia and West Virginia, and then through Kentucky.
zh: 我们必须确保上南部的安全。这意味着我们从马里兰州和特拉华州开始，经过弗吉尼亚州和西弗吉尼亚州，然后经过肯塔基州。

source: The proper way for any Republican to balance the budget is through tariffs -- not through some radical change to the tax system.
zh: 任何共和党人平衡预算的正确方法是通过关税，而不是通过对税收制度进行一些根本性的改变。

source: Women can vote now in Colorado, Utah, Idaho, and Wyoming. This certainly can't hurt you in those states.
zh: 女性现在可以在科罗拉多州、犹他州、爱达荷州和怀俄明州中投票。在这些州，这当然不会伤害你。

source: This is a bread-and-butter response with emphasis on your bread-and-butter issue.
zh: 这是一个重要的回应，重点是您的重要问题。

source: You have made a strong appeal to farmers with this response. Make sure you appeal to the industrial classes as well as you move forward.
zh: 您的这一回应向农民发出了强烈呼吁。确保您能够吸引工业阶层并继续前进。

source: This is a good appeal to those in industry, but many in the middle class are skeptical of unions.
zh: 这对工业界来说是一个很好的吸引力，但许多中产阶级对工会持怀疑态度。

source: This makes a broad appeal to your potential coalition while emphasizing the centrality of free silver to your campaign.
zh: 这对您的潜在联盟具有广泛的吸引力，同时强调自由铸银对您的竞选活动的中心地位。

source: You're hitting McKinley hard on the currency issue, which will especially appeal to voters in the West and the South.
zh: 你在货币问题上严厉打击了麦金莱，这对西方和南方的选民尤其有吸引力。

source: The Democratic base is solidly against tariffs, but keep in mind the fact that the crucial Midwestern states have a more nuanced view.
zh: 民主党基础坚决反对关税，但请记住，重要的中西部各州的观点更为微妙。

source: McKinley is a Civil War veteran and a patriot, but he is also the favorite. You need to vigorous if you're to have a chance.
zh: 麦金莱是一位南北战争退伍军人和爱国者，但他也是最受欢迎的。如果你想有机会，你就必须充满活力。

source: This could be a way to reach out to moderates, but most silver Republicans hail from the West.
zh: 这可能是接触温和派的一种方式，但大多数银本位共和党人来自西方。

source: By and large, the American people respect the Constitution and don't want to see measures like this put into place.
zh: 总的来说，美国人民尊重宪法，不希望看到这样的措施付诸实施。

source: This is a vague answer, but one that is easily used to paint you as a radical.
zh: 这是一个模糊的答案，但很容易被用来将你描绘成激进分子。

source: Hitting back at the conservative propaganda-mongers is definitely your best bet.
zh: 反击保守派宣传贩子绝对是你最好的选择。

source: This answer is a good way to emphasize that you wish to change things within the system.
zh: 这个答案是强调您希望改变系统内的事物的好方法。

source: There's no right or wrong answer -- just be aware that your support will take a small hit in the rest of the country as you tour the isolated West Coast.
zh: 答案没有正确或错误之分 - 只是要注意，当您游览偏僻的西海岸时，您的支持会在该国其他地区受到轻微打击。

source: There may be a method to your madness, but if you're going to go all the way out West, why not stay for a few days and build some real enthusiasm?
zh: 也许有一种方法可以让你疯狂，但如果你要一路走出西部，为什么不停留几天并建立一些真正的热情呢？

source: Not a bad choice. You don't want to distance yourself from the primary arena just as the campaigning picks up.
zh: 不错的选择。您不想在竞选活动开始时就远离主要舞台。

source: Grover Cleveland may have won New York, but he was also from New York. A lot of things will need to go right for you to win there this year.
zh: 格罗弗·克利夫兰也许曾赢下纽约州，但他自己也 来自 纽约州。今年要想在这里获胜，许多事情都得恰好顺利才行。

source: True to form, you packed the streets of the Lower East Side and whipped the crowd into a frenzy. The New York Times filled its pages with sensational headlines and terrified editorials.
zh: 一如往常，你挤满了下东区的街道，让人群陷入疯狂。这 纽约州次 的页面充满了耸人听闻的标题和令人恐惧的社论。

source: True to form your answer is either mocked or taken for the Gospel. It all depends on the person who is asked.
zh: 确实，您的答案要么被嘲笑，要么被视为福音。这完全取决于被问到的人。

source: You have appeased Mr. Tillman without coming across as a firebrand in the North.
zh: 你安抚了蒂尔曼先生，但没有在北方留下煽动者的印象。

source: Your heart is in the right place, but Southern leaders are furious. Your allies might be able to smooth this over once, but there are rumblings of support now for John Palmer.
zh: 你的心是在正确的地方，但南方领导人很愤怒。你的盟友也许能够一次平息这件事，但现在有支持约翰·帕尔默的传言。

source: This is what Mr. Tillman and others wanted to hear, but there are rumblings in the Midwest that you are too friendly with extremist elements in the former Confederacy.
zh: 这是蒂尔曼先生和其他人想听到的，但中西部有传言说您对前南部邦联的极端分子过于友好。

source: There's nothing wrong with campaigning in the Midwest.
zh: 在中西部竞选没有什么问题。

source: It's a bad sign when a Democrat has to compete for Maryland and Delaware, but if you do win there you should have a good shot at this election.
zh: 当民主党必须竞争马里兰州和特拉华州时，这是一个坏兆头，但如果你确实在那里获胜，你应该在这次选举中有很好的机会。

source: This plays into criticism of you as a radical, but there are some people who favor taxing the rich.
zh: 这引起了对你作为激进分子的批评，但有些人赞成对富人征税。

source: A Democrat supporting tariffs? Not a good political move for you.
zh: 民主党支持关税？对你来说这不是一个好的政治举动。

source: Settle into your parlor and await the telegraph results. Best of luck good sir, you have fought a brave battle.
zh: 进入客厅等待电报结果。祝你好运，先生，你打了一场英勇的战斗。

source: New York politics are dominated by a highly corrupt, patronage-based outfit known as Tammany Hall. Their boss, Richard Croker, has so far been indifferent to your campaign. Are you willing to make concessions to arouse his enthusiasm?
zh: 纽约州政治由一个高度腐败、以赞助为基础的组织（称为坦慕尼协会）主导。他们的老板理查德·克罗克（Richard Croker）迄今为止对你的竞选活动漠不关心。你愿意做出让步来激发他的热情吗？

source: Corrupt organizations such as Tammany Hall drag the good name of the Democrats through the dirt. I would never debase my Christian ideals for their support.
zh: 坦慕尼协会等腐败组织拖垮了民主党的好名声。我绝不会因为他们的支持而贬低我的基督教理想。

source: Croker is probably worried about my views on the temperance issue. I will assure him that a Bryan Administration will not push for Prohibition.
zh: 克罗克可能担心我对禁酒问题的看法。我将向他保证，布赖恩政府不会推行禁酒令。

source: I'm sure that Croker is concerned about the patronage positions his men will receive. Patronage jobs for New York men will be plentiful in my administration.
zh: 我确信克罗克担心他的手下将获得的庇护职位。在我的政府中，纽约州男性的赞助工作将会很多。

source: Perhaps there is a misunderstanding. I will defend labor unions, fight against the temperance movements, and ensure adequate patronage jobs for New York Democrats. All I ask in return is that they deliver New York to the ticket.
zh: 或许存在误会。我将捍卫工会，与禁酒运动作斗争，并确保为纽约州民主党人提供足够的庇护工作。我所要求的回报是他们将纽约州交付到票上。

source: You've written off New York but preserved your good name. Your chances of winning there were always negligible in any case.
zh: 你已经注销了纽约州，但保留了你的好名声。无论如何，你获胜的机会总是微乎其微。

source: You may have helped yourself in New York, but a lot of other places are concerned about the temperance issue. They thought you were on board with their beliefs.
zh: 您可能已经在纽约州中帮助了自己，但很多其他地方都担心禁酒问题。他们认为你认同他们的信念。

source: This is somewhat effective, but the number of patronage jobs is dwindling each year and other states are worried about how many there are to go around.
zh: 这在一定程度上是有效的，但是赞助职位的数量每年都在减少，而其他州则担心有多少职位可供分配。

source: Bryan Caves to Tammany Hall! -- says the New York Times. Your position is much improved in New York, at an expense to your national reputation.
zh: 布赖恩通往坦慕尼协会的洞穴！ ——说 纽约州次。你在纽约州中的地位得到了很大的提高，但代价是你的国家声誉。

source: Would you support an Amendment to the Constitution allowing the people to vote for their Senators directly?
zh: 您是否支持宪法修正案，允许人民直接投票选举参议员？

source: Would you support federal "Blue Laws" to protect the sanctity of Sunday?
zh: 您会支持联邦“蓝色法”来保护星期日的神圣性吗？

source: What is your position on Rural Free Delivery of the mail, signed into law earlier this year by Grover Cleveland? Is this an acceptable strain to place on the finances of the Post Office?
zh: 您对格罗弗·克利夫兰今年早些时候签署的农村免费邮件投递法律持什么立场？这对邮局的财务造成的压力是可以接受的吗？

source: Should the federal government make an effort to build a canal through Nicaragua to more efficiently link trade in the Atlantic and Pacific Oceans?
zh: 联邦政府是否应该努力修建一条穿过尼加拉瓜的运河，以更有效地连接大西洋和太平洋的贸易？

source: In an unusual move, the Populist Party has supported you for President while nominating their own running-mate. The man is Thomas Watson of Georgia -- a known radical. What do you have to say about this bizarre situation?
zh: 民粹党在提名自己的竞选搭档的同时支持您竞选总统，这是一个不寻常的举动。此人是佐治亚州的托马斯·沃森 (Thomas Watson)——一位著名的激进分子。对于这种离奇的情况你有什么想说的呢？

source: Horace Boies, the former Governor of Iowa, will be making a big speech tomorrow to capitalize on the crowds at the State Fair. Will you make the overnight trip to Iowa in time to deliver a concluding address to the farmers there?
zh: 霍勒斯·博伊斯，艾奥瓦州的前州长将于明天发表大型演讲，以利用州博览会上的人群。您能及时连夜赶往艾奥瓦州，向那里的农民发表总结讲话吗？

source: We need to focus more on Indiana and Michigan. Iowa should already be in the bag for us.
zh: 我们需要更多地关注印第安纳州和密歇根州。艾奥瓦州应该已经在我们的包里了。

source: Boies's time has passed. We need to avoid appearing with such radical politicians and cultivate the moderate wing of the party.
zh: 博伊斯的时间已经过去了。我们需要避免与这些激进的政客一起出现，并培养党内的温和派。

source: Absolutely. I would be honored to give this speech.
zh: 当然。我很荣幸能发表这次演讲。

source: We have chosen our running mate and our ticket is set. I don't know what they are trying to accomplish.
zh: 我们已经选择了竞选搭档，我们的竞选组合也已确定。我不知道他们想达到什么目的。

source: If they can get a Bryan-Watson ticket on the ballot, good for them. We will sort this issue out after we win the election in November.
zh: 如果他们能在选票上获得布赖恩-Watson 票，对他们有好处。我们将在 11 月份赢得选举后解决这个问题。

source: It's a shame that this policy wasn't implemented decades ago. For too long, rural Americans have been forced to travel up to thirty miles to retrieve the mail they are entitled to.
zh: 遗憾的是这项政策几十年前没有实施。长期以来，美国农村地区的人们被迫长途跋涉三十英里来取回他们有权领取的邮件。

source: We should monitor this program very carefully to determine if it can be done in a cost-effective manner.
zh: 我们应该非常仔细地监控该计划，以确定它是否可以以具有成本效益的方式完成。

source: This policy will hurt the small storeowner and serves as yet another example of wasteful government spending. We should be looking to reduce the deficit -- not to add new programs.
zh: 这项政策将伤害小店主，并成为浪费政府支出的又一个例子。我们应该寻求减少赤字——而不是增加新项目。

source: The current system for selecting Senators is unimaginably corrupt. State legislatures have every incentive to select the most corrupt, retrograde candidate for the job.
zh: 当前的参议员选举制度腐败得难以想象。州立法机构有充分的动机选择最腐败、最倒行逆施的候选人担任该职位。

source: I neither support, nor do I oppose this idea for an Amendment. My job as President will be to enforce the law as it stands.
zh: 我既不支持也不反对这个修正案的想法。作为总统，我的工作就是执行现行法律。

source: The purpose of the Senate is to act as an objective legislative body. It is dangerous to tamper with the Constitutional provisions established by our founding fathers.
zh: 参议院的目的是充当客观的立法机构。篡改我们的开国元勋制定的宪法条款是危险的。

source: At the very least, a federal law prohibiting the sale of alcohol of Sunday seems appropriate.
zh: 至少，禁止周日销售酒精的联邦法律似乎是合适的。

source: This debate has no place in our system of federalism. The individual states have every right to decide how they wish to handle the issue of commerce and drinking on Sunday.
zh: 这场辩论在我们的联邦制体系中没有地位。各州完全有权决定如何处理周日的商业和饮酒问题。

source: I don't support the mandated closing of shops on Sunday.
zh: 我不支持周日强制关闭商店。

source: I envision an American canal, built by American workers, property of the American government, supporting the actions of a robust American Navy. I fully support these plans.
zh: 我设想一条由美国工人建造的美国运河，属于美国政府的财产，支持强大的美国海军的行动。我完全支持这些计划。

source: This could be a fantastic method of creating work for our idle workers. What better way is there to implement a massive public works project?
zh: 这可能是为闲散工人创造工作的绝佳方法。还有什么更好的方法来实施大型公共工程项目呢？

source: Am I understand that we will be sending thousands of men to dig through the hills of Nicaragua on this pipe dream of a project? Allow me to predict that there will never be a canal in that country.
zh: 我是否理解，我们将派遣数千人在尼加拉瓜的山上挖掘这个白日梦项目？请允许我预测那个国家永远不会有运河。

source: Senators should be selected by state legislatures. Why on earth would you want to debase the dignity of that body?
zh: 参议员应由州立法机构选出。你到底为什么要贬低那个身体的尊严？

source: Boies is a controversial figure to be sure, but he more or less falls into line with your traditional views. Of course, there are a lot of states besides Iowa you need to visit if you're to have a chance...
zh: 博伊斯确实是一个有争议的人物，但他或多或少符合你的传统观点。当然，如果你有机会的话，除了艾奥瓦州之外还有很多州你需要去参观......

source: It's a bit much to say that Boies's day is over, although he is a bit past his political prime.
zh: 说博伊斯的日子已经结束有点过分了，尽管他已经过了他的政治巅峰期。

source: Iowa is a key state and this should help you there.
zh: 艾奥瓦州是一个关键状态，这应该对您有所帮助。

source: You can't even get your answer right on the mail issue? Farmers want free mail and they're tired of being ripped off by local storeowners.
zh: 您甚至无法在邮件问题上得到正确的答案吗？农民想要免费邮件，他们厌倦了被当地店主欺骗。

source: Do you approve of Grover Cleveland's handing of the federal budget over the previous four years?
zh: 您是否赞成格罗弗·克利夫兰过去四年对联邦预算的处理？

source: What do you say to the notion that high tariffs hurt farmers?
zh: 对于高关税伤害农民的观点，您有何看法？
